newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Dairy Farm Intl hits new low.
newsitem.headline: Dairy Farm Intl hits new low.

text.p: Food retailer and manufacturing group Dairy Farm International, part of the Jardine Matheson group, hit a new 1996 low of $0.55 in late trading before recovering to close at $0.60, up $0.015 on Thursday.
The stock saw also led the actives with 6.2 million shares traded.
Dealers said some analysts have downgraded the stock after it reported a 55 percent drop in interim net profit to $28 million.
"Fund managers are not interested in the stock any more because of the poor results and prospects," said a dealer with a local bank.
Dealers said recent negative publicity over the fund management activities of Jardine Fleming Holdings also dampened sentiment towards the stock. Jardine Fleming is partly owned by Jardine Matheson.
